description: Reproducible public-database retrieval and exploratory analysis for tables and datasets without unrelated document-conversion tooling.

rules.reason: Structured research materials need retrieval or exploratory data-quality analysis.
Comparing paper-linked records needs documented database retrieval and source provenance.

interface.short_description: Retrieve and inspect structured research data.
interface.long_description: Retrieves data from documented public APIs and profiles tables or datasets with explicit quality, missingness, and leakage checks.
interface.default_prompt: Help me retrieve or inspect this structured research dataset.
